text:
sarah_cs: Customer (acct: redco-54321) reports recurring timeouts and 5xxs from /v1/rerank at ~13:27 UTC. They see p95 jump from ~120ms to >3s and a bunch of gateway 504/502. I'm attaching a repro payload and a recent request-id. Escalating to eng/sre.

nishit: thanks, sarah. can you paste the request-id + the candidate list size? any client-side batching?

sarah_cs: request-id: req_20260317_8f9a3c. Candidate list length ~250 in this customer's calls (they said they send maxCandidates=250). They batch up 4 user queries in one call (candidates duplicated per query). They said this started after they increased QPS from 120 -> 800.

maya: putting this on my radar. do we have gateway logs for req_20260317_8f9a3c? any backend 5xx or just gateway timeouts?

eli: pulling traces now. Looks like gateway served 504s while downstream ranker timed out at ~2.5s. I see retries from client (3 retries sometimes) which may cause fanout.

eli: snippet from gateway trace: ```
grpc gateway -> rerank-service: POST /rank (streaming disabled)
request_id=req_20260317_8f9a3c
qps_window=13:26:30-13:27:00
concurrency=220
latencies: p50=140ms p95=2.6s p99=4.8s
errors: 504 gateway_timeouts=18 502 backend_5xx=3
```

nishit: candidate list of 250 * 4 queries = 1000 ranker items per request. Our rerank path does per-candidate scoring and KV cache is cold for many keys; KV cache miss + long serialization can blow up tail. Also large per-request serialization size might hit gRPC frame handling.

maya: can you share the actual JSON payload sample the customer used?

sarah_cs: pasted below (sanitized):
```json
{"queries": ["What is X?", "How to use Y?", "Price for Z?", "Alternatives to W?"], "candidates": ["<250 candidate strings...>"], "maxCandidates": 250, "timeout_ms": 2000}
```

eli: two immediate observations: 1) they set timeout_ms=2000 -- shorter than our p95 during the spike. the client retries on timeout which increases load. 2) maxCandidates=250 is above our recommended default (we usually suggest 50-100 for production).

ops_oncall: deploy-bot just posted an autoscaler event at 13:28: ```deploy-bot: autoscaler scaled rerank-pool from 12 -> 16 nodes (pending warm-up)```

maya: good. node scale helps but warm-up takes ~20s. we need mitigations: advise customer to reduce maxCandidates and disable aggressive client retries for now. also add server-side concurrency cap per connection.

nishit: can we reproduce in staging? I'll craft a load test that sends batched requests with candidate lists of 200-300 and similar retry behavior.

eli: quick repro steps for staging:
1) spawn 50 clients, each QPS=5 => ~250 QPS total
2) each request: 4 queries + 250 candidates (payload ~> 600KB)
3) client retry policy: retry on non-200 with backoff=0.1s, max_retries=3
Expected: p95 tail increases and gateway 504s once concurrency crosses ~200.

sarah_cs: customer accepted a mitigation: lowering maxCandidates to 80 and disabling retries for 10 minutes while we monitor. they've also limited burst QPS from 800 -> 220.

ops_oncall: after the mitigation we saw p95 drop back to ~180ms within 60s. gateway 504s stopped. autoscaler backfill completed around 13:49.

eli: follow-ups:
- Rerank service: add better payload size rejection + a soft cap warning in the gateway when candidate_count > 150.
- Gateway: add per-connection inflight cap and a more conservative default retry policy for callers.
- Devex: update docs to call out recommended candidate limits and client retry guidance.
- CS: notify affected customer of recommended client changes and timeline for server-side improvements.

maya: creating an internal ticket: RNK-1347 to track server fixes and doc updates. tagging nishit + eli.

sarah_cs: thanks all. customer still monitoring; they're running reduced config for now. I'll update when they re-enable full traffic. :thumbsup:

nishit: starting staged load repro now; will post artifacts and traces to the ticket (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RNK-1347).

deploy-bot: rollback detector: no rollbacks in the window.

eli: quick note — I saw some JSON parsing warnings in the ranker logs for a few requests: `WARN small-string-escape: unexpected control chars` — likely from unescaped candidate content; we'll sanitize more strictly on ingress.

ops_oncall: marking incident as "mitigated" pending RNK-1347 work items.

sarah_cs: closing loop for now. will reopen if the customer reports more 5xxs. thanks everyone.
